records.notesB: The purple CH3 stem terminates on the identified C block inside the two separate teal backbone rails. It does not attach to the sugar-phosphate rail. C is paired with G. The magnifier leader ends at the same small C-base marker between the left two rails. Its end is distinct from the rail. Abstract substrate overview, not a chemically accurate nucleosome structure or full DNA atomic model. The complete existing goal and synthetic cases supply regulation/context/causality limits.
